C1351.title: Academic Research Confirms Cloud Platform Dangling Resources Can Be Hijacked for Malicious Attacks
C1351.summary: A research paper published at USENIX NSDI 2024 titled 'Cloudy with a Chance of Cyberattacks: Dangling Resources Abuse on Cloud Platforms' confirms that attackers can hijack released but uncleaned resources on cloud platforms, which originally belonged to legitimate organizations.
